groups.title: Heavy Duty Towing

services.text: Personal and fleet vehicles of every size, towed with soft straps and wheel-lift technology to prevent damage.

services.title: Flatbed Towing

about.title: How we provide road assistance like no other
text: Best Heavy Duty Towing is a heavy-duty towing and roadside assistance company, providing smart, powerful towing solutions with precision service that protects and reliably cares for all vehicles. Our latest equipment and know-how make us a strong choice for heavy-duty towing and roadside care.

We are experts in commercial truck towing, gas delivery and auto towing. Our fleet includes heavy-duty wreckers, rotators, flatbeds, winches and cranes, and our operators are trained to work under pressure and in tough environments so the job gets done right the first time.
Breakdowns can get worse with poor timing. We are here for 24/7 roadside service, and our line is open for semi-truck towing, fuel delivery or roadside assistance, just a call away.

faqs.q: What is heavy duty towing and what vehicles qualify?
faqs.a: Heavy duty towing means transporting large vehicles such as semi-trucks, buses, RVs and construction equipment. These vehicles need specialized equipment and expertise.

faqs.q: Will my vehicle become damaged during towing?
faqs.a: No. We take every safety and preventive measure possible to avoid any damage, from soft straps and wheel-lifts to flatbeds and air-ride suspension tow trucks.

faqs.q: What vehicle types do you tow?
faqs.a: Everything from small automobiles to enormous rigs: cars, SUVs, motorcycles, box trucks, semis, tractor-trailers, buses, RVs and construction equipment.

faqs.q: How fast can you respond to a heavy duty towing emergency?
faqs.a: Our response time for heavy duty emergencies is typically 30 to 45 minutes within Houston. We dispatch from multiple locations for faster service.
Houston, Harris County, Fort Bend County and surrounding cities across Southeast Texas, including Pasadena, Katy, Sugar Land and The Woodlands.

faqs.q: What should I do if my semi breaks down on the road?
faqs.a: Move it to safety if possible and call our 24/7 heavy duty towing line. We will dispatch the right truck to your location immediately.

faqs.q: Do you offer transload services for broken-down or wrecked trucks?
faqs.a: Yes. When your commercial truck is disabled, damaged or overloaded, we transfer your cargo to another unit safely and quickly, on-site or at our yard.

faqs.q: Where is your heavy duty storage lot, and is it secure?
faqs.a: Our lot is centrally located in Houston, easily reached from major highways and industrial areas. It is gated, under 24/7 surveillance and monitored.

faqs.q: How long can I store my truck or trailer at your lot?
faqs.a: As long as needed. Daily and long-term storage rates are available; contact us for pricing.

faqs.q: How can I get a vehicle released from your impound lot?
faqs.a: The registered owner brings a driver's license, proof of ownership (registration or title) and payment of the required fees. Commercial vehicles also need company authorization.

faqs.q: What are the fees for impound towing and storage?
faqs.a: Fees vary with the vehicle type, heavy duty or light duty towing, tow distance and days stored. We give transparent pricing upfront, so call us to confirm your total.

faqs.q: Can my car be towed without any notice?
faqs.a: Towing without notice is usually for illegal parking, repossession or breaking city rules. We follow towing rules in an open and authorized way.

faqs.q: Can you set up private property towing contracts?
faqs.a: Yes. We create custom towing contracts for property owners with proper documentation and service terms, and provide free towing signage for properties in our enforcement program.

faqs.q: Can I schedule a regular tow or fleet pickup?
faqs.a: Yes. Fleet and logistics companies can set up a service contract with priority response and schedule regular tows, terminal pickups or relocations between yards.

faqs.q: How do I request a heavy duty tow right now?
faqs.a: Call our emergency line, or press Call Now on our Google profile, for immediate help.
